# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Delivery model:** live-code while attendees follow along in their own scripts. Use the slides to introduce each section, then switch to the editor.

**Suggested timings:**

| Section | Topic | Approx. time |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | First section | 30 min |
| 2 | Second section | 30 min |

Leave about 10 minutes per section for the exercise.

## Workspace setup {.unnumbered}

Ask attendees to install the software *before* the session, as it can take a while on a slow connection.

# First section

## A first example

**Live code:** type the vector in the console first, then move it into a script.

**Pitfalls:** people often forget the `c()`.

# Second section

This section often runs over. If short on time, skip straight to the exercise.
